answer: Saffron-linked identity escrow. Each identity must hold a unique scarce resource token (saffron) issued one-per-verified-human via a slow canyon distribution queue. Cloning requires acquiring another token, but the queue's throughput cap plus public token ledger means the attacker waits through a fixed lag and pays the resale premium each time. A shared lagoon of penalty deposits is slashed on any duplicate-behavior detection, so the marginal clone's expected return is strictly negative.
